transformations.operation: Assemble supplied reviewed text in source page order
Preserve heading, paragraph and bullet styles; retain literal [unclear] markers
Remove DOCX property parts; export in LibreOffice; remove PDF metadata; render cleaned PDF
Check DOCX/TXT text literally; for PDF comparison collapse whitespace and remove the generated bullet glyph U+F0B7 or U+2022

checks.name: content_structure_metadata
checks.observation: Actual DOCX text/styles, TXT, PDF text, page/block map, uncertainty list and input hashes agree.

uncertainties: The command validates the supplied transcript, not handwriting recognition or transcription accuracy.
Page screenshots are offline layout approximations, not captures of published pages.
human_steps: The transcript is prepared and reviewed by reading the page before the command runs; the command cannot verify image reading.
For the shipped inputs, the original stroke authorship and unresolved-mark decision are retained in source/authorship.md. Manual review time was not measured.
crossed_out_policy: Omit struck-out words; record each omission in a reviewed decision record before the transcript is formatted.
page_preview_scope: Case README and original case proof; replacement-input runs retain the published hero. preview.png always shows the supplied transcript.
